scope: Independent analysis of all final local EQ CSVs and PNG decodability; no additional test run; Linux local measurements only.

source_provenance.identity_caveat: Working source matches beb72f5 exactly, but generated executable build metadata still identifies baseline360a2d8. Do not present these binaries as a cleanly configured beb72f5 release or test installer.

analyzer_cpu.interpretation: Synthetic consumer cost. Equivalent one-core percent = mean update wall microseconds *25 /10000. Includes no-FFT calls. Not DAW/audio-driver or whole-process CPU acceptance.

native_high_rate.interpretation: Real native event pump with synthetic full-processBlock producer, ten seconds per configuration and no snapshots. Process CPU sums the whole process across threads; 100% represents one core, so values above100% are possible. Remaining queue samples are accounted pending samples, not drops. Local Linux results do not establish that the historical macOS loss is fixed.

native_ui.interpretation: Includes snapshot work; first component render completion does not measure display presentation or monitor refresh. High-resolution real-window acquisition is slower.

eq_dsp_cpu.interpretation: Legacy pair24 EQ DSP benchmark; CSV has p50/p99 only, so it cannot establish zero individual deadline misses.

images.checks: Pillow verify plus full decode; no manual appearance approval inferred.

caveats: rawDB is the latest actual FFT, while smoothed/displayDB preserves attacks from earlier windows. A later raw floor does not invalidate successful displayed detection.
Immediate40ms display is not guaranteed for all late attacks/high FFT sizes. Temporal fixtures are steady-state, primed with N real silent samples; all detected within their bounded observation tail.

There are2 EQ-pair callback deadline overruns and separately2 whole-processor overruns. Passing p99 tests does not establish that all individual callbacks meet deadlines; causation is not established by these observations.
Native192k update-time and consumer-gap outliers remain. All six sample flows were conserved and within5% nominal production, but native performance is explicitly NOT_ASSESSED.
All evidence here is local Linux evidence, not macOS, Windows DAW, device-driver, final installer, or10/23 user acceptance.
Configured local executable version identity still points to360a2d8 despite source files exactly matching beb72f5.
assessment: Local functional correctness, attack coverage, FIFO accounting, automation/preset contracts, and passive audio invariance pass. Observed deadline/timer outliers and deliberately unassessed native performance prevent a final real-time or installer acceptance conclusion from this dataset alone.
